name: Inline comment anchors to selected prose
subject: subjects/review-plan.md
selection: any report table as a CSV file
notes: Baseline prose case. The original complaint: comments landed on whole sections and couldn't be reopened to edit. This guards selection-anchored commenting + full edit/delete + export round-trip.

name: Comment on a diff (line-level is acceptable)
subject: subjects/review-diff.patch
notes: Decision 2026-05-29: per-line commenting on a literal diff is fine, so this intentionally does NOT require span-level `anchor`. It only guards that commenting + edit/delete/export still work on a diff.

name: Highlight survives a selection crossing inline formatting
subject: subjects/formatting-spec.md
notes: The cross-boundary failure mode: selecting from plain text INTO inline `code`/bold/link. Naive highlighting (range.surroundContents) throws here and silently drops the highlight. SKILL.md commit 450c992 added a hint to steer the model to a robust per-text-node highlighter; `crossAnchor` is the regression guard for it.
